section_completion_log.section_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

revision_actions.description: Resolve the sequencing tension by stating that a provisional stress-target and validation protocol are fixed and documented before the month-3 freeze (with D1.1/D1.2 as their formalisation), or adjust the D1.1/D1.2 due months so the defining protocol and harmonised base precede D2.1.
revision_actions.reason: The month-3 D2.1 freeze and month-14 D1.1/D1.2 due months remain as scheduled in sub-section 1.1; explicitly reconciling them (provisional-target-before-freeze wording or adjusted due months) requires new/rewritten prose, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Add an explicit statement of the new, citable scientific knowledge the validation framework yields and what is currently not achievable, so the beyond-the-state-of-the-art claim rests on a demonstrable advance rather than process rigour alone.
revision_actions.reason: Sharpening the beyond-SotA claim with an explicit statement of new citable knowledge and what is currently not achievable requires new prose in sub-section 1.1; Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Evidence that the modelling/EO training capacity at ELTE is secured (imminent associated-partner and co-supervision confirmations) and describe the host-side continuity safeguard for the central training strand if the associated-partner arrangement changes.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 1.3 states the ELTE arrangements as declared assumptions but contains no host-side continuity safeguard for the central modelling/EO training strand should the associated-partner arrangement change; adding that safeguard requires new prose — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Introduce conditional, method-anchored expected-effect ranges (detection lead-time, water-productivity improvement envelopes the design is powered to show) so the project's own magnitude is quantified as a defensible expectation, not only literature context.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.3 deliberately declines any project-specific quantified target and gives only bounded literature ranges; adding conditional method-anchored expected-effect envelopes requires new prose and figures beyond the current framing — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Provide a month-by-month effort-loading view at the WP1/WP3/WP4 overlap and show how partner in-kind support offloads the fellow, to demonstrate the single-researcher concurrency is feasible.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 3.1 provides only WP-level PM totals and a month-span Gantt, not a month-by-month effort-loading view at the peak WP1/WP3/WP4 overlap; producing that view is new prose/table content — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Reassign WP3 scientific leadership to the fellow/beneficiary with the farmer site as a hosting environment, and cite the T3.1 access agreement and contingency ladder as the mitigating controls.
revision_actions.reason: WP3 lead remains stated as 'the independent commercial-farmer validation site' in sub-sections 3.1/3.2; reassigning scientific leadership to the fellow/beneficiary requires rewritten prose — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Foreground concrete modelling/EO artefacts (existing DrR functionality, datasets, tool outputs) to evidence hands-on capability while keeping the honest competence-gap framing.
Anchor the employability breadth in one or two concrete post-fellowship trajectories and cite the specific career KPI used to measure the career outcome.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.1 retains the broad destination spread and refers only generically to 'the project's own career KPI'; naming one or two concrete post-fellowship trajectories and the specific career KPI requires new prose.

revision_actions.description: Add a small set of measurable dissemination/uptake indicators (audiences reached, farmer participants, MVP evaluation users) tied to named channels, proportionate to a single-researcher action.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.2 states output counts only (papers, one demonstration and one article per year) with no quantified audience-reach/uptake indicators; adding measurable reach indicators tied to named channels requires new prose.

revision_actions.description: Quantify the near-term reachable segment (e.g. processing-tomato area in the target countries) alongside the EU-domain figure so the scale claim is graduated from what the action touches to the wider potential.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.3 provides EU-domain figures and Bulgarian downstream context but not a graduated near-term reachable processing-tomato segment for the target countries tied to what the action itself can deliver; adding it requires new prose.

revision_actions.description: Renumber the work packages consecutively or add a one-line note that the former WP2 was merged into WP1, so the numbering gap is not read as an omission.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 3.1 lists WP1, WP3, WP4, WP5 with no in-section note explaining the missing WP2; adding a merge note or renumbering the work packages requires a prose change.

revision_actions.description: Reinforce participating-organisation capacity by evidencing the operational competence that substitutes for a research track record and confirming that PIC registration and host Part A legal-status verification are in hand before submission.
